# William Edward Miller

William Edward Miller may refer to:
*William E. Miller (1914–1983) was an American politician who served in the United States House of Representatives.
*William E. Miller (soldier, born 1836) (1836-1919), Pennsylvania state senator from 1899 to 1902, Captain in the civil war
*William E. Miller (Iowa judge) (1823–1897), justice of the Iowa Supreme Court
